fusions.name: Bristling Mail
fusions.desc: Spikes thrust out from your armour, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Through the Visor Slit
fusions.desc: Throws a needle that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores its armour, plus 5% of the target's maximum health if it is a boss or elite.

fusions.name: Sewn-In Plates
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% while it holds.

fusions.name: Gap in Every Harness
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
